hero.title: The Archive
hero.question: What survives change?
hero.body: Continuity is more than storage. It is the preservation of enough history, context, relationship, and meaning for what came before to remain recognizable after change.

archive_statement: The Archive preserves more than facts. It preserves the relationships that allow facts to remain meaningful.

principles.title: Source before interpretation.
principles.body: What was preserved remains distinguishable from what was later understood.

principles.title: Append, don't overwrite.
principles.body: Corrections and changes become part of history rather than erasing it.

principles.title: Unknown remains unresolved.
principles.body: Absence of an answer is not permission to manufacture one.

principles.title: Permission survives publication.
principles.body: Public presentation never becomes authority over its source.

closing.title: Memory is one current.
closing.body: Discovery asks what it reveals. Creation asks what can grow from it. Connection asks what should no longer remain isolated.
